headline: SSH opened to 0.0.0.0/0 exposes every app instance to the public internet

findings.evidence_ref: security.tf: new ingress rule sets cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"] on port 22/tcp
findings.explanation: Any host on the internet can now attempt to authenticate to the app instances over SSH; the stated goal (on-call access) does not require an open-world CIDR — restricting to the on-call team's egress IPs, a VPN range, or a bastion security group would achieve the same result without the exposure.
